THREE DIRECTIONS — pick one, kill two.

Same content on every board: band 1,750–1,950 · 512–712 left · 5/7 days · 78.4 kg · Gold, 0.71, holds at 0.65.

Fixed in all three (safety, not taste): no punishment copy · missed day renders EMPTY, never crossed · no red for going over · tier readable without colour · weights visible on the breakdown · band, never a single number.

Everything else is up for grabs. React to what pulls you — the winner gets the other four screens.

A · GAUGE — your pick, raised.
The orange mock rebuilt as a real instrument: calibrated band scale, notch tally as the tier mark, Archivo numerals + Martian Mono micro-labels, one burnt-orange accent.
Risk: dark + hot accent is a known AI look — the discipline (ticks, tabular digits, no glow) is what separates it.

B · SPLIT-FLAP — the wildcard the dice dealt.
Departure board: every live number in its own flap tile, amber on true black, B612 Mono (a real cockpit face), GOLD spelled out in tiles. Your NetDiary density, as a board.
Risk: novelty vs daily comfort — tiles carry data only, labels stay calm.

C · MATCHDAY — the bold one.
League-table broadcast: drenched pitch green with mowing stripes, chalk lines, tiers as divisions (chevrons carry the count), consistency as a form guide, Saira Condensed.
Risk: strongest metaphor, most football-coded. Also the only one that isn't black.
